_comment: The GPU types the pool knows. names: every string nvidia-smi prints for the type. vram_mib: the nominal size; a card is accepted inside nominal x [0.90, 1.05] unless vram_mib_min / vram_mib_max give a measured window. status: qualified = admitted (the proof has been measured on a real card of the type); listed = known but not admitted yet. Names and sizes of the listed types are Lium's (gpu_spec_table.py, 10/5) and are confirmed on a real card when the type is qualified.
